title: DS stepper gets the scrub, arithmetic and arrow-key behaviour its spec promises
goal: The number fields in the study are documented as ones you can drag sideways to change, type simple math into, and nudge with the arrow keys, but none of that actually works and each page wires up its own partial version. This builds the behaviour once so every number field does what it promises.
notes:
STAGE-GATE DROP 2026-08-23. Serves design-system (staged next, every child later) while focus is measure-redline. redline.html has no number fields at all, so this unblocks nothing in focus, and the mock corpus stepper is HTML/CSS that has no path into the Next release SwiftUI controls. Reopen when design-system is staged now. Everything below was verified against the corpus, and the original notes were substantially wrong.

CONFIRMED. input.css lines 20-25 promise four behaviours: the label is a scrub handle, the field accepts arithmetic (320/2, +16), it steps with arrows and 10x with shift, and spinners appear on hover. .stepper>.k carries cursor:ew-resize, so the drag affordance is drawn. There is no stepper.js anywhere in the repo and no stepper entry in shared/components/order.json.

CORRECTED - the page list. 13 files mention the word stepper, but only SEVEN render one: comp-fields 15, comp-panels 4, comp-index 3, ui-grid 3, video.html 3, ui-autolayout 2, video-motion 1. That is 31 in total. The other six (creation-vision, component-configure-wt, composites, documents, iconography, img-grade-wt) only mention it in prose, a spec table or a CSS rule.

CORRECTED - who hand-wires. The notes named ui-autolayout and ui-grid. video-motion.html hand-wires too, and it is the ONLY page in the corpus with any arrow-key support (ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the stagger field, no shift multiplier).

WORSE THAN THE NOTES SAY - the scrub is implemented nowhere. 30 of the 31 steppers carry a .k label, so 30 fields draw a drag cursor over a handle that does nothing. Not one page, including the three that wire spinners, implements the gesture.

WORSE THAN THE NOTES SAY - arithmetic is implemented nowhere. All three wiring pages use parseFloat/parseInt, so 320/2 silently becomes 320 and +16 becomes 16. The spec headline behaviour fails hardest on the pages that look wired.

SPINNERS. Only 12 of 31 steppers have buttons at all; 19 have no .sp, so hovering them shows nothing. Of the 12, six are wired (2 ui-autolayout, 3 ui-grid, 1 video-motion) and six are dead specimens in comp-fields and comp-index. No stepper has an empty .sp, so there is no empty-hover-well bug to fix.

HOW TO BUILD IT. Copy slider.js: idempotent dataset.pz* marking, a PZ.all sweep, and re-dispatch a bubbling input event after writing a value. Register stepper in order.json js after slider. If it dispatches bubbling input, ui-autolayout and ui-grid keep working untouched (both listen on input) and their spinner wiring can simply be deleted. video-motion is the exception: it listens on change and owns its own ArrowUp/ArrowDown, so its keydown block must go in the same pass or arrows will double-step. Preserve ui-grid setNum behaviour of never writing into a field that holds focus, or typing gets fought.
acceptance: Dragging sideways on a number field's label changes its value, on all 30 fields that draw the ew-resize handle
Typing 320/2 or +16 into a number field resolves to the computed number instead of being silently truncated
Arrow keys step the value, Shift steps ten times as far, and every number field that shows spinner buttons responds to them
ui-autolayout, ui-grid and video-motion drop their own wiring and still work, with video-motion no longer double-stepping on arrow keys

log.note: Audited the whole corpus. Verified the spec promise and the absent stepper.js; corrected the page list (7 pages render 31 steppers, not the 2 named), found video-motion hand-wires as well, and found scrub and arithmetic implemented on zero pages while 30 fields draw an ew-resize handle. Notes and acceptance rewritten.
Dropped at the stage gate: serves design-system (next), focus is measure-redline, and no measure/redline page carries a number field.
